data.name: Greenlyte Carbon Technologies
data.description: Greenlyte Carbon Technologies is a German DAC startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Essen. The company operates a liquid-sorbent DAC process that co-produces green hydrogen, and in November 2025 inaugurated the world's first LiquidSolar SNG plant in Duisburg with 40 tpy CO2 removal capacity. It has offtake agreements with Eurowings and MB Energy and is fast-tracking a 500-ton commercial module at Chempark Marl in 2026.
